name: List counter: giant number
when: Each new item of a numbered list (a top 10, a ranking): the item's number rolls up like an odometer on the cut to its first shot, holds a beat, and rolls out before the item plays. It shows the number only; the item's name is said by the voice (or put in a caption).
anchor: The reels hit full speed on the cut to the item (`cut`, 0.12 s after the scene starts): start the scene 0.12 s before that cut.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.number: the item's place in the list, 1 to 999 (one window per digit; the units reel counts on from the previous item)
vars.cut: seconds after the start: the cut to the item's first shot (at least 0.12; keep 0.12 and start the scene 0.12 s before the cut)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the number rolls out (validated 0.6 s after the cut; the scene ends 0.27 s later)

changed: The units reel lands in 0.38 s after the cut instead of 0.4 s, so it lands within 0.5 s of its first move (0.12 s before the cut). The lab showed #11 to #13 in one composition; here each item is one scene and any number from 1 to 999 gets one window per digit.
